reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports compliance: Section 11.2 imposes a defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation on Harpoon (counterparty) in favour of AbbVie (our party) and its Affiliates and their directors, officers, employees and agents, and Section 11.1's mirror obligation on us is drafted no more broadly, so this is not a one-way Customer indemnity (walk-away territory is not present).

Standard indemnity procedure required by the preferred position is present (11.3 prompt notice with no forfeiture for delay; 11.4.1 indemnifying-party control of defence subject to 7.4–7.6), and p0471 confirms third-party patent-infringement claims are routed through Section 11.2 with Harpoon as potential indemnitor, satisfying the IP-infringement element; the deterministic check for an IP indemnity also passed.

No monetary cap is imposed on the counterparty's indemnity, which is better than the fallback's 3x super-cap; the rationale correctly treats the redacted [***] trigger lists as a confirmation item for the unredacted execution version rather than as a material deviation, which is the right handling of a sub-element short of verifiable preferred wording.

Rationale is accurate against the supplied paragraphs and definitions (AbbVie Indemnitees per 11.2, Losses/Third Party Claims per 11.1); no over-flagging and no double-counting with limitation-of-liability rules.
